purpose: Proposed direct manual-handler steps for four currently empty inventory procedures. They do not complete the four inventory permission dimensions, the conditional CDP type focus precondition, any runtime cell, or any feature/mode claim. This file changes no inventory cell.

shared_setup.public_demo: https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html is Selenium's public Web form demo. Its observed page lists a text input, default checkbox, select, and submit button. Never enter a credential, choose a file, or submit the form. Before execution verify the live page still presents the named controls; if it has changed, stop and keep the case unverified.
shared_setup.build_and_roles: Admit the appropriate resource permit. In separate member and admin profiles load the exact candidate development extension, record source commit, lockfile hash, build receipt, extension ID/version/Loaded from path in chrome://extensions, Chrome version, and signed-in role. Tools is sign-in gated; guest has no manual Tools case. Do not infer member dispatcher access from a direct manual run.
shared_setup.tab_identity: Open only a disposable public-demo tab. In Tools > Catalog choose All handlers; run list_open_tabs with {} and record the one tab ID whose full URL matches the demo. Keep that tab selected when running CDP input; canonical form_input and navigate require the same ID as a decimal string. Do not use an unrelated or authenticated tab.
shared_setup.manual_runner: Search each exact name, open its row, verify the displayed input schema and tier, enter the complete JSON, click Run, and inspect the inline output/error plus the real page. The manual runner validates Zod then calls handler.run with permissionMode=act and assignedTabId=null; it bypasses dispatcher approval and cannot establish the agent's assigned-tab or role/permission enforcement.
run_phases: Warm: where all case-specific preconditions are met, execute positive and negative segments after loading the candidate extension without a preceding full extension Reload; record result, visible page state, tab ID, and immediate debugger banner/attachment delta.

Post-reload: where all case-specific preconditions are met, use chrome://extensions Reload for that exact extension, confirm the same extension ID/version/path, reopen Tools, refresh the disposable demo page, reacquire its tab ID and any read_page ref/bounds, then repeat the same segments. A web-page refresh or side-panel reopen alone is insufficient.
shared_setup.permission_boundary: All four inventory permissions dimensions remain unresolved. The two CDP input handlers declare privileged tier and debugger; debugger is a base manifest permission with no Settings revoke switch. The direct Tools Run path skips requestConfirmation and optional-permission checks. A future separately mapped Chat/Pilot dispatcher denial needs the exact tool advertised to the tested role, a known owned tab, Ask mode for action tools or the mandatory privileged card for CDP, a human Deny, and an unchanged-page oracle. No such live route or refusal was established by this source-only proposal. Malformed JSON, stale refs and invalid tab IDs are not permission tests.
shared_setup.cleanup: Admin only: record cdp_attached_tabs baseline and the owned debugger banner, then record the owned attachment/banner immediately after each positive CDP run. If still attached, use cdp_detach for exactly the owned ID and confirm disappearance. If it has already idle-detached or a worker restart swept it, record that state without claiming explicit cleanup; cdp_attached_tabs is only the current worker's in-memory set. Member: do not use admin-only helpers through the manual gate bypass; close only the disposable demo tab and confirm its banner clears. Preserve pre-existing attachments and unrelated tabs.

proposed_case_patches.name: cdp_input_click_xy
proposed_case_patches.source_readiness: Direct manual steps are specified; positive click, member/admin behavior and dispatcher permission denial remain native-unverified.

preconditions: Shared setup above; Chrome with debugger capability, signed-in member/admin, exact loaded build, disposable Selenium Web form tab and numeric tab ID.

The live page shows an unchecked Default checkbox. Run read_page with {"tab_id":"$TAB_ID","include_bounds":true}; identify that visible checkbox's unique type=checkbox row, unchecked state and fresh viewport bounds. If ambiguous, stop.
steps: Admin records cdp_attached_tabs baseline; member records the owned tab and debugger-banner state without the admin-only helper. Record the checkbox's current checked state. Calculate x=round(bounds.x+bounds.w/2), y=round(bounds.y+bounds.h/2); verify the target center is inside the visible viewport and is the checkbox, then focus the owned tab.
Tools > Catalog > All handlers > cdp_input_click_xy. Run {"x":$X,"y":$Y,"button":"left","click_count":1,"tab_id":$TAB_ID} with numeric replacements from the same fresh read_page output.

Immediately after the positive run, record the owned debugger banner or admin attachment delta before idle timeout/restart can remove it. Observe the real checkbox checked state and repeat read_page for the same owned tab; require the default checkbox row now checked. Do not click Submit.

Schema-negative: run {"x":"bad","y":$Y,"tab_id":$TAB_ID}; verify inline Schema mismatch and unchanged checkbox state. Record an attach failure separately if Chrome refuses the debugger; it is an environment/error outcome, not a permission-denial pass.
Repeat warm and post-reload phases in shared setup, recomputing coordinates after each page load. Clean up only the owned attachment/tab.
expected: Positive inline output is {"ok":true}; the exact default checkbox visibly changes from unchecked to checked and read_page confirms checked=true. Output alone is insufficient.
Malformed x is rejected before Input.dispatchMouseEvent and leaves the checkbox unchanged. No permission claim follows from this schema refusal.

Record attachment/banner state immediately after input. Explicit cleanup, already-detached state and an owned-tab close are distinct outcomes; absence at a later check alone does not prove no attach occurred or that cdp_detach ran.

proposed_case_patches.name: cdp_input_type
proposed_case_patches.source_readiness: Conditional: before this direct manual positive can be accepted, one native smoke must prove the actual web input remains focused across side-panel Run and receives Input.insertText. This source-only lane cannot resolve that focus boundary.

preconditions: Shared setup above; Chrome with debugger capability, signed-in member/admin and exact disposable Selenium Web form tab ID.

The public page still has one visible non-password Text input. Input.insertText does not focus a target. Clicking Run occurs in the side panel and may shift focus; source inspection alone cannot establish that the web input remains document.activeElement. A native focus/value smoke is an unresolved precondition.
steps: Admin records cdp_attached_tabs baseline; member records the owned tab and debugger-banner state without the admin-only helper. Tools > Catalog > All handlers > cdp_input_type. Focus the demo's Text input in the web page; then run {"text":"matrx-4106","tab_id":$TAB_ID} using the numeric owned tab ID. The tester must record the web document's actual focused element at the Input.insertText boundary in a native smoke, not infer focus from a caret seen before Run.

Immediately after the positive run, record owned debugger banner/admin attachment delta. Inspect the actual Text input; require visible value matrx-4106 and no form submission or navigation. Then run read_page for the owned tab and check the corresponding non-sensitive text-input value. If focus or value is wrong, leave positive and reload dimensions unverified and determine a reproducible focus method before repeating.
Schema-negative: run {"text":17,"tab_id":$TAB_ID}; require inline Schema mismatch and unchanged text. If focus was lost, record that separately and reacquire focus before judging the positive case.

Only after the focus/value smoke passes, repeat warm and post-reload phases, clearing/re-focusing the field after refresh. If it fails, test a paired owned-tab CDP click on the input immediately before CDP type and verify focus again; do not call the procedure executable until the native value changes. Clean up only the owned CDP attachment/tab.
expected: Conditional positive: inline output is {"ok":true}, the web document's focused element at Input.insertText is the intended Text input, and that field visibly contains exactly matrx-4106. {ok:true} without the field/value/focus evidence is not a pass.
Malformed text is refused by the local schema before Input.insertText and leaves the input value unchanged. No permission claim follows from this schema refusal.
No Submit action or page navigation occurs. Immediate attachment/banner state is recorded; later absence may be idle/worker detach and cannot substitute for explicit cleanup evidence.

proposed_case_patches.name: form_input
proposed_case_patches.source_readiness: Direct manual positive and error steps are specified; member/admin runtime and dispatcher permission denial remain unverified.

preconditions: Shared setup above; signed-in member/admin, decimal string tab ID and public demo Text input visibly present. The page is not a credential or submission fixture.
Run read_page with {"tab_id":"$TAB_ID"} and identify one fresh ref for the visible non-password Text input; do not guess a ref or reuse it after navigation/read_page reassigns attributes.
steps: Tools > Catalog > All handlers > form_input. Run {"tab_id":"$TAB_ID","ref":"$TEXT_REF","value":"matrx-4151"} using the exact fresh ref and decimal string tab ID.

Inspect the real Text input and run read_page to verify value matrx-4151. This read_page removes/reassigns all data-matrx-ref attributes, so save the NEW ref it now reports for the same Text input as $REF_BEFORE_REFRESH. Do not click Submit or enter secrets.

Refresh the web page normally; before any new read_page, run {"tab_id":"$TAB_ID","ref":"$REF_BEFORE_REFRESH","value":"matrx-stale"}. Require {"ok":false,"reason":"No element for $REF_BEFORE_REFRESH"} and unchanged input. This isolates page-refresh invalidation from the earlier read_page reassignment. Separately use {"tab_id":"not-id","ref":"$REF_BEFORE_REFRESH","value":"matrx-4151"} for explicit invalid-tab refusal.
Repeat warm and post-reload phases; reacquire a fresh ref after every page refresh and extension Reload.
expected: Positive returns {"ok":true,"tag":"input"} and the exact field visibly contains matrx-4151. activateTab can switch browser focus; compare the same owned tab ID before/after.

The ref saved from the last read_page before page refresh returns No element for that ref after refresh, with no intervening read_page; the refreshed field stays unchanged. Invalid tab ID returns {"ok":false,"reason":"Invalid tab_id: not-id"}. Neither is an approval-denial test.
The form remains unsubmitted and no unrelated tab is changed.

proposed_case_patches.name: navigate
proposed_case_patches.source_readiness: Direct manual positive and invalid-tab steps are specified; member/admin runtime and dispatcher permission denial remain unverified. A load timeout is not completion evidence.

preconditions: Shared setup above; signed-in member/admin, disposable tab with recorded decimal string ID and an initial public https://example.com/ page. Verify the Selenium demo target responds and displays Web form before invoking navigation; stop if unavailable.
Use the exact target URL https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html. The force argument is accepted but unused by this handler; omit it and do not claim force behavior.
steps: Tools > Catalog > All handlers > navigate. Record the disposable tab's initial example.com URL and ID. Run {"tab_id":"$TAB_ID","url":"https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html"} with the actual decimal string ID.

After navigate returns, run list_open_tabs with {} in Tools, locate exactly the same owned tab ID, and require status complete there and in navigate's returned result. Separately inspect that tab's full target URL and visible Web form heading/text-input. If the owned row is absent, status remains loading, or the page did not settle, record failed/inconclusive navigation even if the handler returned after 30 seconds; investigate before repeating.
Negative: run {"tab_id":"not-id","url":"https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html"}; require {"ok":false,"reason":"Invalid tab_id: not-id"} and no navigation of the owned tab.

For post-reload phase, return only the disposable tab to https://example.com/ through normal browser UI, reload the exact extension in chrome://extensions, reacquire tab ID, reopen Tools and repeat. Close only the disposable tab afterward.
expected: Positive requires returned url equal to the Selenium target, returned status complete, list_open_tabs status complete for exactly the owned tab ID, and the same tab visibly showing the Web form page. waitForLoad resolves on either a complete event or a 30-second timer; it does not guarantee complete. A missing/loading tab row or timeout result is failed or inconclusive, not a pass. Its title is observed, not assumed as a fixed oracle.
Invalid tab ID is refused by activateTab before chrome.tabs.update; the owned tab stays on its pre-negative URL.
Manual Run establishes direct canonical routing through navigate_active_tab only; Ask-mode consent, agent assigned-tab isolation and member advertisement remain separate unverified dimensions.

limits: No runtime/browser/build/DB/credential step was performed here. The public demo may change; every execution must verify its live control inventory before applying this proposal.

The checked-in form-controls.html is a stronger owned observable fixture but its /form-controls route currently exists only inside a terminating unit-test server; it is not a ready manual native URL. See .research/form-fixture-fresh-peer.json. These procedures use the public demo and retain visible-result checks instead of inventing a persistent owned server.

The manual Tools runner bypasses dispatcher gates and uses focused-tab fallback. All four permissions dimensions, privileged/action confirmation denial, request-time member/admin advertisement, and true agent-assigned-tab behavior remain unresolved; a separately mapped dispatcher execution with a verified advertised tool/role and human Deny is required before any permission outcome can be promoted.

EXT-F-4106 positive and post-reload execution remain conditional on a native focus/value smoke proving that Input.insertText reaches the intended page field after the side-panel Run interaction. Source alone cannot establish it. No runtime cell may pass from this proposal.
